description: Learner budget: LightGBM on the champion's features (market state + momentum, no added family) with se1_lgbm_mm's tree params but 3x the training rows (max_rows 900k) and up to 1000 rounds (early stopping 50). se1's fits stop at or near its 300-round cap. Chosen after a development comparison of four learner budgets on 10-18..10-20 (DESIGN_V1 section 19); its development gain over se1 (+0.0027 nats dir_2h) is therefore selected and optimistic. Prospective scoring decides. Not embargoed (no family).
